newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux says whitegoods markets fell.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux says whitegoods markets fell.

text.p: Swedish applicance maker Electrolux posted a 14 percent fall in earnings on Tuesday for the first quarter of the year, saying the European and U.S. whitegoods markets contracted.
The company also said lower sales volumes and a less favourable product mix hurt the group's European operations.

The company posted a profit of 777 million crowns after tax for the first three months of the year compared to 901 million crowns in the same 1996 period. It said sales rose four percent to 28.72 billion crowns.

"The European market for whitegoods decreased in volume in comparison with the first quarter of 1996," Electrolux said in a statement. "Volume in the U.S. whitegoods market was slightly lower," it added.
Average market expectations put the profit after financial items on 910 million crowns. The share plummeted 16 crowns or 3.4 percent to 457 crowns after the result was published.
